title: Actuators pulled out of portals

tellings.quote: that and actuators with this John Silison guy that there's these actuators that they pull out of the portals

plain: The UFO researcher Grant Cameron passes on a claim from a man named John Sillison: that there are "actuators," moving mechanical parts, that "they pull out of the portals." Cameron repeats it as something he was told and does not say who "they" are or what the portals are. If it were true, it would mean someone is recovering hardware from openings to somewhere else.
